title: ActiveCampaign Review (2026)
intro: ActiveCampaign is evaluated here as email marketing software — a marketing automation ESP with multi-step journeys, segmentation, and CRM pipelines that strengthen on Plus and above. Pricing is contact-based with no forever-free plan and a published Starter→Enterprise ladder. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s email-marketing methodology (ease of use, email creation, automation, segmentation, analytics, deliverability tooling, integrations, scalability, value, AI). It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose ActiveCampaign when multi-step email automation is the primary job and CRM on Plus+ is a supporting system of record.
verdict: Choose ActiveCampaign when multi-step email automation is the primary job and CRM pipelines on Plus+ are a supporting system of record — not when you only need a sales CRM or ecommerce SMS attribution. Compare Klaviyo or Omnisend for ecommerce email/SMS, Brevo for send-based value, GetResponse for free-tier all-in-one entry, and HubSpot when suite freemium CRM is the center of gravity. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Mature marketing automation UX; learning curve rises with multi-step journeys and CRM surfaces on Plus+ — approachable for automation buyers, less ‘simple newsletter’ than MailerLite.
Campaign and automation email builders are core to the product — strong composition for marketing-led senders rather than a design-agency ESP story.
Multi-step email automation and workflow depth are ActiveCampaign’s category strength versus typical SMB newsletter ESPs — the reason it holds Best Email Marketing automation award.
Conditional journeys and contact-based segmentation support deep list/behavior targeting for automation-led programs — stronger than beginner freemium ESPs.
Campaign and automation reporting are solid for SMB/mid-market email programs; ecommerce revenue-attribution depth still trails Klaviyo-class retail stacks.
Standard ESP deliverability posture for a marketing automation platform — not a specialist verification/inbox-placement product like Bouncer or InboxAlly.
Broad app ecosystem for marketing/sales stacks documented in first-party research.
Professional/Enterprise contact-tier packaging supports growing list volumes; very large enterprises may still compare suite MAPs.
No forever-free plan; contact-based costs rise with list size — excellent when automation depth is the job, weaker for freemium or CRM-only buyers.
Documented AI assistance for email generation, automation support, and recommendations — meaningful for automation buyers, not the sole purchase reason.

faq.question: Is ActiveCampaign email marketing software or a CRM?
faq.answer: SoftwareGlimpse evaluates ActiveCampaign primarily as email marketing / marketing automation. CRM pipelines are available and strengthen on Plus+, but they are secondary to the automation job.

faq.question: How much does ActiveCampaign cost?
faq.answer: No free plan. Contact-based USD annual research floors at ~1k contacts: Starter ~$15, Plus ~$49, Professional ~$79, Enterprise ~$145 /mo. 14-day trial. Confirm live pricing.

faq.question: Does ActiveCampaign have a free plan?
faq.answer: No forever-free plan. A 14-day free trial is documented.

faq.question: Did SoftwareGlimpse personally test ActiveCampaign?
faq.answer: No. This review is based on first-party product and pricing research evidence, not hands-on product usage.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: ActiveCampaign is a marketing automation platform centered on multi-step email journeys, segmentation, and campaign sending, with CRM/sales pipelines that become most useful on Plus and higher contact-based plans.

sections.heading: Who it’s for

• Marketing-led SMBs that need automation as the primary email job
• Email-first GTM teams comparing HubSpot or Keap on journeys
• Buyers comfortable with contact-tier packaging who want CRM on Plus+

sections.heading: Pricing
sections.body: No free plan. Contact-based USD annual research floors at ~1k contacts: Starter ~$15, Plus ~$49, Professional ~$79, Enterprise ~$145 /mo. 14-day trial. CRM strongest Plus+. Confirm live pricing — packaging can change.

sections.heading: Limitations
sections.body:
• No forever-free plan — 14-day trial entry only
• Contact-tier pricing scales as the list grows — confirm live bands
• CRM depth is secondary to email automation identity
• Not the strongest ecommerce SMS + revenue-attribution stack vs Klaviyo/Omnisend
• Not a specialist deliverability or list-hygiene tool
